decision_conditions: Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until further details of the balcony construction, including materials and screening, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until further details of the staircase feature to the front of the site are submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works for the roof terraces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.
description: Following outline approval for the erection of 46 flats with access from Hanworth Road, associated parking, amenity space and landscaping -details submitted pursuant to the reserved matters Condition 1 (relating to external appearance and landscaping) of permission reference number 01254/139-147/P3 dated 3/8/2006.
